items.title: Cassius Wilson Interview, 1962-04-05
items.q: we had this boy, Dookie Chase, young Dookie Chase, he played for us.

ctx.x: Did you ever hire a rock and roll band to play for your dancers? Yes. You have rock and roll?

Yeah, we had this boy, Dookie Chase, young Dookie Chase, he played for us. And this band I'm telling you about, no, I can't call a name of them youngsters, they're a rock and roll band, they play good music too.
